author: Francescoparadiso

commands.name: search-data
commands.title: Search Data
commands.subtitle: QR Code Sharing

commands.name: export-data
commands.title: Export Data
commands.subtitle: QR Code Sharing
commands.description: Choose a folder and save a CSV with every entry there, for backup or to restore later.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: qrSize
preferences.title: Code Size
preferences.description: How large the code is rendered. Medium fills the default Raycast window; use Large only if your window is taller.
